insane-driver.fansOf: For fans of Alter Bridge, Pantera, Black Label Society and Metallica

silicon-fortress.fansOf: For fans of Alter Bridge, Dream Theater, Breaking Benjamin and Killswitch Engage

singleDescriptions.waiting-for-you: Waiting for You is a song about resilience, about refusing to break while time slips away. For fans of Alter Bridge and Black Label Society.
singleDescriptions.the-sun-will-rise: The Sun Will Rise carries a hopeful message: whatever adversity comes, things will turn out okay. For fans of Alter Bridge and Shinedown.
